info.title: Suwappu Agent API
info.description:
Cross-chain DEX API for AI agents. Swap tokens across 7+ chains via structured endpoints.

## Errors
Errors come in two envelope shapes:

1. **Handler / validation errors** — `{ "success": false, "error": "...", "message": "...", "fields": {...} }`. Returned for validation failures (400), forbidden wallet ownership (403), and not-found resources (404) raised inside route handlers.
2. **Gateway errors** — `{ "error": "...", "requestId": "...", "timestamp": "..." }`. Returned by the global error handler for auth failures (401), rate limiting (429), and unhandled errors (500).

The `Error` component schema is permissive and covers both shapes; the per-operation examples show the exact body for that case.

## Rate limits
Authenticated endpoints are rate-limited per agent by tier (sliding 60s window): `free` = 30 req/min, `agent` = 100 req/min, `pro` = 500 req/min. Public endpoints are rate-limited per client IP. On 429 the response includes `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

post.description: Fetch (or reuse a cached `quote_id`) and report whether the swap would succeed, WITHOUT signing, broadcasting, or persisting anything — zero funds move. Runs six independent safety checks (route_available, balance_sufficient, allowance_sufficient, gas_affordable, eth_call_revert_check, slippage_sane); each degrades to a `warn` with `unavailable`/`not applicable` detail rather than failing the whole request when it can't run (e.g. no `wallet_address`, or a Solana quote for the EVM-only allowance/eth_call checks). Authenticated and rate-limited by tier; may be metered (x402) at the same 1-credit rate as /quote.

post.description: Execute a swap from a cached `quote_id` using the agent's managed (Turnkey) wallet. The agent must have created a wallet via POST /wallets first. Authenticated and rate-limited by tier; may be metered (x402). get.description: Fetch INCIDENTS.json - known outages/gaps in the archive's capture history (cached ~5 minutes). Public endpoint, no auth required.

Given a start/end ISO 8601 UTC range (capped at 168 hours per request), resolve the deterministic hourly Parquet file URL for each hour, choosing the era per hour (preferring v3, then pmxt/v2, then third-party/ag6, then pmxt/v1 on overlap unless era is pinned). Hours outside every known era span are returned with outsideKnownSpan: true rather than dropped. Pure URL construction - does not download or verify file existence. Public endpoint, no auth required.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Range end, ISO 8601 UTC (inclusive). Floored to the top of the hour. Range capped at 168 hours.

parameters.name: era
parameters.description: Pin every hour to this era instead of auto-resolving from the span registry.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint over the MCP Streamable HTTP transport (JSON-RPC 2.0). Lets MCP-capable agents discover and invoke Suwappu tools (`get_quote`, `execute_swap`, `get_portfolio`, `predict_markets`, …), read resources (`suwappu://openapi.json`, `suwappu://chains`, token lists) and fetch prompt templates natively. Authenticated with the same agent API key as `/v1/agent/*` (Bearer). Quotes created here share a cache with `POST /v1/agent/quote`, so a quote_id from either surface works in the other. Note: this endpoint is mounted at the API root (`https://api.suwappu.bot/mcp`), not under `/v1/agent`.

Error.description: Standardized error body. Two shapes exist: handler/validation errors include `success: false` and `error` (and optionally `message`, `fields`, `hint`); gateway errors (auth/rate-limit/unhandled) include `error`, `requestId`, and `timestamp`. All fields are documented here; any given error uses the relevant subset.

fields.description: Per-field validation errors keyed by field path.

example.amount: amount must be a positive number

hint.description: Actionable hint for fixing the request.

service.description: Upstream service name on external-service errors.

example.message: amount must be a positive number
